levels.title: Beginner Baker
levels.description: Measure accurately, knead with confidence, and proof your first dough.

modules.title: Measure & Mix
modules.summary: Weight over volume — flour hydration starts with accurate scaling.
modules.practice_query: simple muffin or quick bread with proper measuring
teaching: Use a scale for flour — cups compress and ruin hydration.
Whisk dry ingredients together before wet for even distribution.
Read the recipe twice before preheating the oven.

modules.title: Knead & Proof
modules.summary: Develop gluten, then let yeast do the lifting.
teaching: Windowpane test: stretch a small piece until translucent without tearing.
Proof until doubled — poke test should spring back slowly.
Salt controls yeast speed; never let salt touch yeast directly in dry mix.

modules.title: Score & Bake Bread
modules.summary: Steam, score, and listen for the hollow thump of a finished loaf.
modules.practice_query: crusty artisan loaf with scored top
teaching: Score at a shallow angle with a lame or sharp knife — controls oven spring.
Steam in the first 10 minutes for crackling crust.
Internal temp 190–210°F for lean breads; thermometer beats color alone.

levels.title: Home Baker
levels.description: Cookies, cakes, and the chemistry of creaming and folding.

modules.title: Creaming & Cookie Science
modules.summary: Room-temp butter, sugar crystals cutting air — the cookie foundation.
modules.practice_query: chewy chocolate chip cookies with creamed butter
teaching: Butter must be cool-room-temp — too soft and cookies spread flat.
Cream until pale and fluffy; sugar dissolves partially into butter.
Chill dough 30 minutes for thicker cookies with better flavor.

modules.title: Fold & Gentle Mix
modules.summary: Preserve air in batters — stop when streaks remain.
modules.practice_query: genoise or chiffon cake with folded batter
teaching: Cut through center, scrape bottom, fold over — do not stir.
Fold dry into wet in thirds; deflating less is more.
Stop when a few flour streaks remain; over-mixing toughens cake.

modules.title: Blind Bake Tart Shells
modules.summary: Par-bake pastry so fillings stay silky, not soggy.
modules.practice_query: blind-baked tart shell for lemon curd
teaching: Dock the shell with a fork — steam escapes, fewer bubbles.
Line with parchment and pie weights; bake until edges golden.
Brush egg wash on hot shell to seal against wet fillings.

levels.title: Bread Baker
levels.description: Enriched dough, fermentation timing, and sourdough thinking.

modules.title: Enriched Dough
modules.summary: Butter, eggs, and sugar change gluten and browning — brioche rules.
teaching: Add butter in stages after gluten develops — fat inhibits early kneading.
Enriched dough proofs slower; watch volume, not the clock.
Egg wash gives shine; milk wash gives soft brown crust.

modules.title: Laminate & Croissant
modules.summary: Butter block, letter folds, and the science of flaky layers.
teaching: Butter and dough must be same consistency — cold but pliable.
Rest between folds; gluten relaxes, butter stays in layers.
Proof laminated dough until jiggly — under-proofed layers stay dense.

modules.title: Long Ferment & Flavor
modules.summary: Overnight retards and preferments for complex bread flavor.
teaching: Cold retard slows yeast, develops acid and aroma.
Starter must be active — floats in water at peak.
Score deeper on high-hydration doughs for controlled expansion.

levels.title: Pastry Cook
levels.description: Chocolate, custards, and precision on the pastry station.

modules.title: Temper Chocolate
modules.summary: Crystal structure for snap, shine, and stable decorations.
modules.practice_query: tempered chocolate bark or dipped strawberries
teaching: Seed method: melt 2/3 chocolate, stir in remaining finely chopped.
Work at 88–90°F for dark chocolate; thermometer is mandatory.
Test on parchment — sets glossy in 3 minutes or retemper.

modules.title: Custards & Setting
modules.summary: Temper eggs into hot dairy — silky crème without scramble.
teaching: Temper by ladling hot cream into eggs slowly while whisking.
Strain custards through fine mesh — silky texture, no chalazae.
Bake in water bath; edges set, center still wobbles slightly.

modules.title: Macaronage & Meringue
modules.summary: Fold almond batter to ribbon stage — feet come from technique.
teaching: Macaronage: fold until batter ribbons off spatula like lava.
Rest piped shells until skin forms — touch without sticking.
Low oven, steady temp; open door cracks shells from shock.

levels.title: Pastry Chef
levels.description: Sugar work, plated desserts, and pastry menu architecture.

modules.title: Sugar Work & Caramel
modules.summary: Cook sugar to thread, soft ball, and hard crack with safety.
modules.practice_query: salted caramel sauce or spun sugar garnish
teaching: Clean pot sides with wet brush — sugar crystals seed premature crystallization.
Caramel goes from perfect to bitter in seconds; cold bath stops carryover.
Never touch hot sugar; water bowl nearby for burns.

modules.title: Piping & Finish Work
modules.summary: Consistent pressure, temperature, and garnish discipline.
modules.practice_query: decorated layer cake with piped buttercream
teaching: Buttercream at 68°F pipes clean — too warm slumps, too cold tears.
Practice on parchment before committing to the cake.
Garnish should echo flavors inside — citrus zest on lemon cake, not random mint.

modules.title: Plated Dessert Architecture
modules.summary: Temperature contrast, sauce placement, and the three-bite rule.
modules.practice_query: plated dessert with sauce, crunch, and temperature contrast
teaching: Build bottom to top: sauce, crunch, mousse, garnish.
Odd numbers on the plate look intentional — threes and fives.
Cold plate for chilled desserts; warm sauce only if designed to flow.

levels.title: Master Baker
levels.description: Production scale, recipe R&D, and mentoring the pastry brigade.

modules.title: Production & Scaling
modules.summary: Batch formulas, fermentation schedules, and oven loading strategy.
modules.practice_query: scale bread recipe from 4 to 40 loaves with baker's percentages
teaching: Baker's percentages: flour is always 100%, everything else relative.
Stagger oven loads for consistent bake — know your hot spots.
Document floor time and dough temp; seasons change fermentation.

modules.title: Recipe R&D & Documentation
modules.summary: Test, version, and hand off formulas the brigade can repeat.
modules.practice_query: develop and document signature house viennoiserie
teaching: Change one variable per test batch — fat %, hydration, fold count.
Photo each stage for training cards, not just the finished item.
Version numbers on recipes; never overwrite without saving the prior winner.

modules.title: Mentor & Quality Control
modules.summary: Taste panels, waste tracking, and building the next pastry lead.
modules.practice_query: pastry quality audit with scoring rubric for brigade
teaching: Daily taste panel: one item from each station, scored blind.
Track scrap and rework — quality and margin live in the same spreadsheet.
Promote on teaching ability, not just technical skill.
